notes.text:
I2C_INT: open-drain wired-OR -> U4 IO7 (R-INT-01)
  U5 BQ25628 ~INT: 256 us low pulse (SLUSEG4C 8.3.8.3)
  U17 TCA6408A ~INT: touch P4 + ACC_INT P5 (SCPS192E 8.3.3)
FW: on falling edge read TCA6408A input + Charger_Flag_X
Pull-up: ESP32 internal on GPIO7, rise ~1 us << 256 us (R-INT-03)
IO7 wakes light sleep only, not deep sleep (R-INT-04)
